note: THE GROUND DECLARES NOTHING, AND THAT IS THE MEASUREMENT AND NOT AN OMISSION. This fragment carried four textures: terrain-albedo and terrain-light, the painted meadow and its Cycles bake, and terrain-detail and terrain-path, the two maps of the paving that travelled here because the ground's own material ate them. All four are gone at step 8 of the rifondazione. The meadow is ten centimetre cubes out to the tier's radius and a snapped sheet from there to a hundred metres, and both take their colour from arithmetic in src/world/voxel/material.js; the corridor is columns of that same disc wearing V3's own three maps. Nothing in src has asked for one of these four ids since D3b took the meadow out of the atlas, and step 7 measured what was left of the claim at NOTHING -- not the 16.85% it had been, but no reader at all. An asset is declared where it is eaten, so a fragment for a session that eats none is empty. E-V4f.4 held terrain-light in the critical set until V1 retired its atlas, and E-V3c made terrain-detail and terrain-path a JOINT cancellation of V1 and V3: both conditions are met on the same day and the coordinator's decision (E-FOND-PIANO10) is what closes them together. WHAT IT COST TO CARRY THEM: 4 356 514 bytes of the first frame, which is 70.9% of it, downloaded by every visitor and read by nobody.
